user_problem: A supplied referral program needs consistent invitation language that accurately states eligibility, reward, and limitations.
unique_output: A message kit with inviter text, recipient text, short disclosure, ineligible-case response, and fact trace.
required_input: Program rules, eligibility, reward conditions, expiration, prohibited wording, and approved CTA.
critical_rule: Do not imply guaranteed rewards or eligibility; preserve every condition material to receiving the reward.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is promotion-variant-check; this creates rule-bound referral messages rather than comparing prewritten promotion variants.
acceptance_scenario: Input says existing members receive $10 after a new member's first paid month, expires July 31, staff excluded. Output states the condition and expiry, includes a staff-ineligible response, and avoids 'instant $10.'
